name: Random Mix
summary:
The rhythm game that writes a brand-new song every time you press play. 50+ genres synthesized live. Tap it, remix it, or build your own: you are the DJ and the producer, no music knowledge needed. Fully offline.

A song that has never existed before builds itself around you: drums, bass, melody, all synthesized live on your machine. No downloads or song packs.

Random Mix is a rhythm game with a composer inside.
